$comment: Advisories accepted for now, with a reason and a review-by date. scripts/audit-allow.mjs fails CI on any HIGH/CRITICAL/MODERATE advisory NOT listed here. Match is by GHSA id OR module name. Review-by dates are advisory, not enforced — but a stale entry is a signal to re-check.

allow.reason: Fixed in nodemailer>=9.1.0, but @auth/core@0.41.3 (via next-auth@5 beta) hard-pins the peer to '^7.0.7 || ^8.0.5'. Mitigations in place: no `raw` option, single EMAIL_RE-validated recipient, fixed `from`, 5/hour/email send cap. New Resend HTTP transport (no nodemailer) is the recommended prod path. Bump the moment the peer relaxes.
Vercel AI SDK filetype-whitelist bypass on file UPLOADS. The app never uploads files through the AI SDK. Fixed in ai>=5.0.52; migrating to AI SDK v5 is a breaking major scheduled as its own phase.
Uncontrolled resource consumption in @ai-sdk/provider-utils<3.0.28, transitive via @ai-sdk/*. Same AI SDK v5 upgrade covers it. Provider calls are our own, bounded, and server-side only.
Prototype-pollution class issue in deepmerge-ts<8, transitive via the Prisma CLI at build time only. No attacker-controlled input reaches it. Clears when prisma is bumped.
